meaning: 2D single-muon directional distribution from the LVD reconstruction: azimuth interval, zenith interval, slant rock thickness, raw reconstructed intensity/count-like value.

columns.azimuth_lo_deg, azimuth_hi_deg: native map azimuth interval used by the LVD/nmap-style input table
columns.zenith_lo_deg, zenith_hi_deg: zenith interval in degrees from vertical
columns.slant_rock_m: slant rock thickness along the bin direction, m
columns.intensity_raw: raw reconstructed single-muon map value from rock_int.txt; lvd_tomography fits a global scale to forward flux units
columns.solid_angle_sr: bin solid angle for the listed angular interval
columns.fig7_lvd_azimuth_center_deg: empirical Fig.7 frame center: (43 deg - azimuth_center_deg) mod 360

fig7_projection.weighting: solid-angle weighted mean of intensity_raw over theta bins, then fitted with one positive scale to lvd_paper_fig7_curve.csv
